title: [Kernel][MiniMax-M3] Add opt-in query-tiled sparse prefill
body_opening:
## Purpose

MiniMax-M3 sparse prefill currently launches one Triton program per query token. Adjacent queries often select overlapping sparse KV blocks, so this PR adds an opt-in query-tiled kernel that:

- groups adjacent queries into one program,
- enumerates the distinct union of their selected blocks,
- loads each union K/V block once, and
- gates each block by per-query membership and causality.

The original scalar kernel remains the default. Set `VLLM_MINIMAX_SPARSE_PREFILL_TILE_Q` to `2`, `4`, `8`, `16`, or `32` to select the tiled kernel; unset, `0`, or `1` uses the scalar kernel. Decode is unchanged.

Part of Ngram series https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/21052

This PR removes the old fixed trie/SAM draft-budget split. Instead of reserving draft tokens with `external_sam_budget`, trie and each loaded SAM are treated as candidate sources scored by `score = source_prior * (w_specificity * specificity + w_confidence * confidence)` where `w_specificity` and `w_confidence` are normalized from the user-provided weights.
